items.difficulty_reason: 5 行陈述（94 行证明）、循环交运算与平坦基变换及平坦拉回的相容：局部化 + 素循环约简 + 一般点重数实算 + 双有理搬运 + 具名 chow 交换方块收尾；平坦拉回是特例。全部输入具名（含两件本池被拒卡作引用，0H66/0H67），无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-action-base-change (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2257-2261

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Work locally on Y so beta is a finite combination of prime cycles, reduce to beta a prime cycle by bilinearity, compute both sides of the base-change equality through generic-fibre multiplicities, transport the two component and multiplicity claims through birational morphisms, and finish with the named base-change versus flat-pullback commutative square in Chow Homology; flat pullback is the special case S = Y (source lines 2263-2356)
